paragraphs: Key Data sells lodging market data and analytics used by vacation rental property managers, destination organizations, investors and enterprise analytics teams. The argument it makes is that its figures come from actual bookings rather than estimates read off public listing calendars.

The dataset joins direct-source short-term rental reservation data with Airbnb and Vrbo listing coverage and hotel performance benchmarks. The company states integrations with more than 80 property management systems and direct-source data from more than 17,000 property managers, covering over 1.15 million vacation rental properties. Reporting covers occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, guest nights, booking pace and length of stay.

Destination organizations use it to understand event performance, find high-value feeder markets, time campaigns and report results to boards, elected officials and stakeholders. The company says more than 300 destination organizations choose it. Enterprise teams can take the same data through APIs, flat files, S3 buckets, Snowflake delivery or custom feeds rather than through a dashboard.

quote.text: KeyData is not a pricing tool.
